summary: Ryde Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of 10.5 million Class B ordinary shares to its founder, chairman, and CEO, Mr. Terence Zou, following the achievement of performance-based milestones tied to three capital raises totaling $28.9 million completed from December 2025 to April 2026. The Class B shares carry 10 votes each versus one vote for Class A shares. Post-issuance, Mr. Zou holds 16.74% of total share capital but 66.79% of voting power. The Class B shares are not listed on NYSE American. This is an internal share issuance with no change in control or structural event, not a special situation.
